review_note: Preserves four equivalent tests of quasi-coherence on affine subsite of small Zariski/étale: tensor base-change on all site arrows, qc sheaf on affine ringed site, qc sheaf under ringed-topos equivalence, and restriction from a unique qc O_S-module. Every condition and both site types retained.
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $\tau\in\{\mathrm{Zariski},\mathrm{\acute etale}\}$. Let $S_{\mathrm{affine},\tau}$ be the full subsite of the small $\tau$-site whose objects are affine open subschemes of $S$ (for Zariski), or affine schemes étale over $S$ (for étale), with standard affine $\tau$-coverings and structure sheaf $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{affine}}(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Its ringed topos is canonically equivalent to the small $\tau$ ringed topos $S_\tau$. Let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{affine}}$-modules on $S_{\mathrm{affine},\tau}$. The following are equivalent: (1) for every morphism $U\to U'$ in that affine subsite, the canonical map $\mathcal F(U')\otimes_{\Gamma(U',\mathcal O_{U'})}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\to\mathcal F(U)$ is an isomorphism; (2) $\mathcal F$ is a sheaf and a quasi-coherent module on the ringed affine subsite (locally admitting presentations by possibly infinite direct sums of the structure sheaf); (3) under the ringed-topos equivalence from the affine subsite to $S_\tau$, $\mathcal F$ corresponds to a quasi-coherent module on $S_\tau$; (4) there exists a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module $\mathcal G$, unique up to unique isomorphism, with $\mathcal F(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal G|_U)$ naturally in every affine object $U\to S$.
hypotheses: tau is small Zariski/étale; F is a presheaf of modules on the affine subsite.
conclusions: Tensor-compatible restriction, site-local quasi-coherence, and descent from unique scheme QCoh are equivalent.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-quasi-coherent-alternative-small}
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $\tau \in \{Zariski, \etale\}$.
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a presheaf of $\mathcal{O}_{affine}$-modules
on $S_{affine, \tau}$. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item for every morphism $U \to U'$ of $S_{affine, \tau}$ the map
$\mathcal{F}(U') \otimes_{\mathcal{O}(U')} \mathcal{O}(U) \to \mathcal{F}(U)$
is an isomorphism,
\item $\mathcal{F}$ is a sheaf on $S_{affine, \tau}$ and
a quasi-coherent module on the ringed site
$(S_{affine, \tau}, \mathcal{O}_{affine})$ in the sense of
Modules on Sites, Definition \ref{sites-modules-definition-site-local},
\item $\mathcal{F}$ corresponds to a quasi-coherent module on
$S_\tau$ via the equivalence (\ref{equation-alternative-small-ringed}),
\item $\mathcal{F}$ comes from a unique quasi-coherent
$\mathcal{O}_S$-module $\mathcal{G}$ by the procedure
described in Section \ref{section-quasi-coherent-sheaves}.
\end{enumerate}
